events.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
events.description: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance. It is contested on methodology, the authors are accused of both alarmism and of publishing a recipe, and the argument stays inside the biosecurity community – but it is a categorically stronger signal than anything published so far. **This is a precursor: it opens the bio gate for the next 4 turns.**

events.title: emergent_care_audit_revolt
events.description: A coalition of European hospital networks and insurers publishes an independent audit showing continuity-stack triage helpers systematically under-triage certain patient groups, triggering national-level suspension orders beyond the showcase sites.

events.title: emergent_shadow_clinic_network
events.description: Municipal clinics and small labs quietly pool openly available frontier models into shared diagnostic and triage scripts, creating an ungoverned shadow health-AI network outside EU procurement and oversight.
